plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: bottle anchors the left, a centered logo-over-headline column carries the message, and a right action column groups the CTA with its badge row so nothing hugs the edges.
Copy-led layout: logo and a wide, left-aligned headline block open the read on the left, the bottle sits as a centered visual pivot, and the CTA with badges closes on the right.
Four-column brand strip: logo as a left-edge sign-off, bottle next to it, badges sitting as an eyebrow directly above the headline stack, and a standalone CTA on the far right.
